senses.definition: n.pr.m. Bab. name given to חֲנַנְיָה, one of Daniel’s comrades Dn 1:7 (from and meaning dub.; Dl (cf. COT Dr) Šudur-Aku, command of Aku; JenTh LZ 1895, 329 thinks Pers. [*Khšatraka]; KohlerZA iv (1889), 50 conj. מרדך, so WklAltor. Forsch. iii. 47. 57 ZimKAT3. 396).
